Теперь у меня достаточно контекста. Проведу системный анализ:

```json
{
  "perspective": "Systems Integration & Developer Experience Analyst",
  "key_points": [
    "Dog currently uses JSON envelope format for ALL block outputs: {stage, result, timestamp}",
    "The 'result' field contains Claude's raw response as a STRING (often JSON-stringified)",
    "YAML input configs are parsed reliably, but outputs are JSON-only",
    "File substitution system ({{ filename.json }}) expects JSON and unwraps envelopes automatically",
    "Logic scripts (pre/post/validate phases) receive file paths and parse JSON",
    "Claude API responses are wrapped in envelope regardless of format",
    "Current implementation at dog.py:792-797 hardcodes JSON.dump() with ensure_ascii=False"
  ],
  "pros": [
    "JSON parsing is deterministic and fast (Python json.load() is C-optimized)",
    "JSON structure validation happens at parse-time (fails fast on malformed data)",
    "Envelope format {stage, result, timestamp} provides consistent metadata wrapper",
    "File substitution with json.dumps() ensures safe string escaping automatically",
    "No ambiguity in nested structures (lists, dicts, nulls are unambiguous)",
    "Existing logic scripts already expect JSON format (validate-themes.py, enhance-draft.py)",
    "Claude generates valid JSON reliably when schema is specified in prompt",
    "Compact for machine parsing - no comment overhead",
    "Direct Python dict manipulation without serialization round-trips"
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Double-encoding issue: Claude's JSON response is stringified into 'result' field",
    "Less human-readable than YAML (especially nested structures)",
    "Escaped quotes in stringified JSON reduce readability (\\\"theme\\\": ...)",
    "No native support for comments (workaround: use 'metadata' or '_comment' fields)",
    "Multi-line strings require escaping (\\n instead of YAML's | or >)",
    "Poetry and creative text looks ugly in JSON strings",
    "Manual editing is error-prone (missing commas, quote escaping)",
    "Git diffs are less semantic (quote escaping changes)"
  ],
  "risks": [
    "Claude occasionally generates markdown-wrapped JSON (```json\\n{...}\\n```) requiring parsing",
    "String escaping bugs if logic scripts don't handle nested quotes properly",
    "Human operators editing JSON outputs might introduce syntax errors",
    "Mixing formats (YAML input, JSON output) creates cognitive overhead",
    "Future need for code blocks or templates in outputs will be painful in JSON",
    "Debugging failures requires manual JSON parsing to read error messages",
    "Team adoption: non-technical users struggle with JSON syntax",
    "Version control: YAML diffs are more readable than JSON diffs"
  ],
  "opportunities": [
    "Unified format: YAML for both input AND output improves consistency",
    "Human editing: operators can fix outputs in readable format without JSON escaping",
    "Comments in outputs: document why certain data was generated",
    "Better poetry storage: multi-line literal blocks (|) preserve formatting naturally",
    "Gradual migration: add YAML support while keeping JSON backward-compatible",
    "Validation: YAML parsers catch more errors (duplicate keys, type hints)",
    "Cross-agent communication: YAML is more readable for Claude when ingesting {{ file.yaml }}",
    "Future extensibility: YAML anchors/references for reusable data structures"
  ],
  "initial_recommendation": "HYBRID APPROACH - Keep JSON as primary format but add YAML support as optional output mode. Rationale: (1) JSON parsing is faster and more deterministic for automated systems, (2) YAML is superior for human-edited content like poetry, documentation, or debug outputs, (3) Current codebase has deep JSON integration (envelope wrapping, file substitution, logic scripts), making full migration risky, (4) Add save_format field to blocks (json/yaml/auto), default to JSON for backward compatibility, (5) Prioritize YAML for creative workflows (poetry, prose) and human-facing outputs, JSON for data pipelines and machine-to-machine communication. Implementation: Modify dog.py:792-797 to check block.get('save_format', 'json') and use yaml.dump() when requested, update file substitution to handle both formats, add format detection for {{ file.* }} placeholders."
}
```
